**Recommendation: Sentry**, unless your team is mobile-first (then Bugsnag) or you only want basic error grouping at the lowest cost (then Rollbar). I haven't checked current pricing, so confirm the numbers below on each vendor's pricing page before deciding.

| | **Sentry** | **Rollbar** | **Bugsnag** |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Core strength** | Broadest platform: errors, tracing/APM, session replay, profiling, uptime, logs | Error tracking with strong grouping, RQL query language, deploy tracking | Stability-focused error monitoring, release health, strong mobile SDKs |
| **SDK coverage** | Very wide (web, backend, mobile, games, native), plus many framework integrations | Wide, with solid web and backend coverage | Wide, strongest on mobile (iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter) |
| **Performance / replay** | Built in (tracing, replay, profiling) | Limited compared with Sentry | Performance monitoring exists but is less central |
| **Pricing model** | Free tier, then a team plan with usage-based billing across error, transaction, and replay volume. Costs can climb with traffic spikes unless you set quotas. | Free tier, then per-event tiers with seat-based plans. Simple to predict for error-only use. | Free tier, then event-based plans. Seat costs vary by plan. |
| **Self-host option** | Yes (open source) | No (SaaS only) | No (SaaS only) |
| **Ecosystem / integrations** | Largest (Jira, GitHub, Slack, Linear, many more) | Good core integrations | Good core integrations; owned by SmartBear |
| **Best fit** | Full-stack teams wanting one tool for errors and performance | Teams that want error grouping and simple, predictable costs | Mobile-heavy apps, or teams that care about release stability scores |

**Why Sentry for a 10-person team:**
- One tool covers errors, performance, and replay, so you avoid adding a separate APM later.
- Its SDKs and integrations cover most stacks without custom work.
- Its free tier is enough to evaluate it on real traffic.
- Usage-based costs are manageable if you set event quotas and sampling from day one.

**When I'd pick something else:**
- **Bugsnag:** most of your users are on native mobile apps and you care about crash-free session rates.
- **Rollbar:** you only need error tracking, want predictable seat-based costs, and don't need tracing or replay.

**Before you commit, check:**
1. Your current error volume per month. This drives the cost under each vendor's model.
2. Your stack's SDK support, especially for any mobile or serverless components.
3. Whether you want performance monitoring and session replay in the same tool.
4. Whether you need to self-host for data residency reasons. If so, Sentry is the only one of the three that offers it.

If you tell me your stack and rough monthly event volume, I can make a more specific recommendation and a cost estimate.
